notes:
I couldn't write any notes on Isaiah 4 this time, because I wasn't able to read a single source page.

My first try at loading the commentaries (Enduring Word; Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes, Calvin and Wesley on Bible Hub; Precept Austin) went over the tool's usage limit, and I wasn't allowed to retry. The other tools I have can't reach the internet. Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for each point, and not to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Writing notes now would break that, so I've left them out.

**Next time, I'd read these in order:**

1. **The traditional reading, verse by verse:**
   - enduringword.com/bible-commentary/isaiah-4/
   - biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/isaiah/4.htm
   - biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/isaiah/4.htm
   - biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/isaiah/4.htm
   - preceptaustin.org's Isaiah 4 commentary
2. **Differences between Protestant traditions:**
   - Calvin on ccel.org or biblehub.com (Reformed)
   - Wesley's Notes on biblehub.com or wesley.nnu.edu (Methodist)
   - Searches on gotquestions.org, ligonier.org, desiringgod.org and lcms.org for "Branch of the LORD"
3. **Other views:**
   - netbible.org notes on Isaiah 4 (modern scholarship)
   - newadvent.org (Catholic)
   - oca.org (Orthodox)

If you start a new request, I'll fetch the pages one at a time so I stay under the limit, then write the notes verse by verse with a URL for each point.
